attempts.name: v1
attempts.reason: The response schema used const without an explicit type; the provider rejected it before model output.

attempts.name: v2
attempts.reason: The prompt incorrectly broadened fixed_instance to the dynamic ABI and every workload; its model output is not comparable to the frozen Phase A scope. The controller also misclassified an existing final file because it called the failure classifier on success.

attempts.name: v3
attempts.scope: one fixed-instance canary with complete evidence
attempts.reason: The model declared illegal register Allocations. Removing only those Allocations and matching Buffer references produced an accepted, lowerable, GPU-free compiled successor.

attempts.name: v4
attempts.scope: the remaining eleven fixed-instance cases after one new canary

attempts.name: finalize-v1
attempts.reason: The projection used a nonexistent Lowering.toolchain field; no terminal dataset was written.

attempts.name: finalize-v2
